The drawing defines a 375 mm-wide, 20 mm-thick profile with 25 mm slot pitch, 8 mm slot opening, 14.5 mm lower slot width, 12 mm slot depth and 5 mm lip depth. It gives 15.07 kg/m and defines model length in 100 mm increments, making `PT-600` the 600 mm product identity.

It does not provide PT-600 body CAD, profile tolerances, the countersunk-hole pattern, T-nut/bolt order identities, thread/fastener limits, allowable clamping load, allowable bending/torsion, anchoring requirements, or application acceptance for this rig. Those remain blocking evidence.
